description: The document checklist for one visa route: how far ahead to start, what the paperwork costs beyond the government fee, the first section in full with where to get each document, and the other sections by name and document count. The complete checklist, with tracking, is part of Transita's paid action plan on the website.

visa_id.description: Transita visa id, e.g. 'de-eu-blue-card'. Get ids from transita_match_visas or transita_list_visas.
